# ROM instructions that no coverage player executes (generated by tests/rom_unreached.py, step N05; the reasons are in tests/rom_unreached_reasons.txt)

Addresses and words only; no ROM bytes. Coverage: the S27 replay and the T01a player (N01) and the coverage players A, B, C (N02 to N04, extended in N05) and the service-switch player D (N05).

Result: 5314 of 5439 instructions are executed (97.7 percent). 125 are not; every one of them is listed below with a reason and a decision.

Decision words: PORT = the native game contains it; it is proved either by a play situation or, when no situation reaches it, by the isolated random-state test of its routine (as in T02b to T02h). LEAVE OUT = the native game does not contain it (dead code). N47 = decided in step N47 (power-on self test). PORT AS DATA = it is data, not code.

## Summary by decision
- LEAVE OUT: 24 instructions
- N47: 62 instructions
- PORT: 34 instructions
- PORT AS DATA: 5 instructions

## The groups
| First | Last | Instructions | Kind | Reason | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0038 | 003F | 4 | dead code | RST 38h vector: kicks the watchdog and loops; nothing in the program calls RST 38h and the board raises no such interrupt (the interrupt vector is a ROM table entry) | LEAVE OUT |
| 005A | 005A | 1 | loop end | end of the slot search of the task queue (RST 28h/30h): reached only when all 16 slots are in use, which the game never does | PORT (one instruction) |
| 1B31 | 1B35 | 3 | needs a rare game state | branch of the ghost-house dot counting (1B08 to 1B35): when the flag at 4DA1 is zero the counter 4E0F is incremented; no run produced that combination of flags | PORT; proved with random states in the step of the ghost-house routine |
| 23E8 | 23EC | 3 | table entry | one slot (23D4) of a state jump table, indexed by the state byte 4E04; no run selected it | PORT (it is a table entry: it runs only if the state counter says so) |
| 2B73 | 2B77 | 5 | data inside code | five inline data bytes after a CALL to 2BCD (parameters of the call), listed as instructions by the disassembler; never executed as code | PORT AS DATA |
| 2C44 | 2C5D | 20 | dead code | BCD conversion routine with no caller and no way in (the instruction before it is a jump) | LEAVE OUT |
| 2D07 | 2D0B | 3 | needs a rare game state | sound update (group B, 2CC1 to 2D0B): the branch taken when the byte at 4EEC is non-zero at this point; no run produced it | PORT; proved with random states in the step of the sound routine |
| 2D58 | 2D58 | 1 | loop end | end of an 8-step bit search when the effect byte has no bit set; reached only for an effect byte of zero | PORT (one instruction) |
| 2DB7 | 2DB7 | 1 | needs a rare game state | sound update (group A): parameter cleared when bit 3 of the channel byte (ix+0B) is set; no run set it | PORT; proved with random states |
| 2E28 | 2E28 | 1 | loop end | end of an 8-step bit search when the effect byte has no bit set; reached only for an effect byte of zero | PORT (one instruction) |
| 2F2B | 2F33 | 4 | table entry | entries of the jump table at 2F02 (sound parameter handling) that no run selected | PORT (table entries; they run only if the data says so) |
| 2F3C | 2F54 | 17 | table entry | entries of the jump table at 2F02 (sound parameter handling) that no run selected (11 of them are a bare RET) | PORT (table entries; they run only if the data says so) |
| 3031 | 303F | 11 | power-on self test | RAM test: the path taken when a RAM cell does not hold its pattern (error code to the test screen) | N47 |
| 30B5 | 30BB | 5 | power-on self test | RAM test: the path taken when a RAM cell does not hold its pattern | N47 |
| 30FB | 3151 | 46 | power-on self test | drawing of the RAM-test error screen and wait for the service switch | N47 |
